svg.title: Karl Scraper — Automating tasks
svg.desc: Keep a local copy of my tasks, let AI agents read it, and automate a ticket’s path all the way to its pull request. 18 actions and 14 triggers. Designed and built alone. Personal tool, running on my machine.
